task.question: When Formula 1 returned to Sepang in 2026, how long had it been since the championship last raced there?
task.evidence: Formula 1 returns to Sepang this week for the first time in nine years, with the Malaysian circuit hosting the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
task.page: What was happening in the world the last time F1 raced in Malaysia?

answer:
Formula 1 last raced at Sepang on October 1, 2017. The championship returned there on October 2-4, 2026. Calculating the time difference gives us 9 years.

FINAL: 9 years

On 26 July 2026, Formula One and the FIA officially confirmed that the Sepang International Circuit would host the rescheduled race from 2 to 4 October 2026, filling the calendar gap between the Azerbaijan and Singapore Grand Prix.

On 26 July, Formula One and the FIA announced that Sepang would host the Bahrain Grand Prix from 2 to 4 October. The agreement was reached with the governments of Bahrain and Malaysia, and the remainder of the 2026 calendar was left unchanged. [1]

Sep 30, 2026 · When Formula 1 last raced at Sepang, Max Verstappen drove a Red Bull to victory ahead of Lewis Hamilton and Daniel Ricciardo. The date was 1 October 2017. Nine years later, the circuit returns to the calendar on 2–4 October 2026 as the venue for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

Formula 1 last raced at Sepang on October 1, 2017. The championship returned there on October 2-4, 2026. Calculating the time difference gives us 9 years.

FINAL: 9 years
